title: Fisher-geometric causal memory bank with Mirror basis codes
hypothesis: A shared Fisher-weighted basis plus compact per-memory Mirror codes will preserve causal memory specificity, reactivation, sufficiency/composition and necessity/erasure at >=25% fewer complete bytes than independent traces, and strictly beat native PCA factorization.

development.tuning: none; closed-form Fisher whitening, SVD, and residual ranks 0/1/3

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed after native factorization alias or causal/byte gate miss.

controls: shared plus private residual ranks 1 and 3
metrics: leakage to other memories after erasure
success_gate: PASS only if all four causal checks pass (reactivation <=0.02, specificity >=0.99, composition <=0.02, necessity >=0.99 with other-memory erasure leakage <=0.01), complete bytes are >=25% below independent, and Mirror strictly beats native PCA.
failure_gate: FAIL if any causal check/byte gate misses or native PCA matches Mirror exactly.
boundaries: Synthetic associative-memory vectors only; no AI Engram replication or cognitive claim.
Nine memories share an aligned rank-3 span; three private exceptions are constructed.
Private basis is fit from observed exception traces and fully charged; no unseen-memory generalization is tested.
Fresh seeds remain sealed after alias or gate miss.
